name: Implacable
body:
You refuse to retreat from even the most deadly of confrontations.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: If you move out of melee combat, for any reason, you suffer a -2 on all attack rolls, skill checks and saving throws for 1 hour.
